messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: customer-impacting latency spike detected for customer 'northstar' (p99 streaming latency > 12s) — triggered at 2026-03-14T04:56:07Z. Notify: #incidents, @alice_oncall.

alice_oncall: saw the page. investigating. can someone pull the streaming traces + recent rollout events? 

davinder_sre: on it. pulling p95/p99 graphs from grafana. quick summary: p50 ~ 120ms, p95 ~ 900ms, p99 ~ 12.4s, error rate ~ 0.8% (mostly timeouts on streaming). link: https://grafana.redwood/clusters/streaming?panel=northstar

miguel_runtime: adding logs from runtime: we're seeing repeated "kv_cache_miss" churn + long tail mulligan on the streaming multiplexing path. relevant log snippets:
```
[04:55:58Z] model-serving-42 stream_conn_id=0x7f time_to_first_chunk=0.12s
[04:55:59Z] model-serving-42 stream_conn_id=0x8a time_to_first_chunk=8.9s kvcache_evictions=47
[04:56:01Z] model-serving-43 stream_conn_id=0x8b stall_detected=true stalled_ms=8700
```

miguel_runtime: looks like a combination of long prefixes + a high concurrency burst from northstar test harness. their sessions include large system messages (6–8k tokens) and multi-part JSON outputs that force large KV writes.

lia_prodeng: northstar confirms they rolled a new prompt templating change ~T-12m that concatenates debug metadata into the system prompt. Tom from CS is on call with them.

tom_cs: northstar says they started a canary where every request includes a 4kb debug blob. they thought it was safe. they're seeing 20–30qps burst per tenant worker. they are paused now.

davinder_sre: mitigation options: 1) immediate: apply tenant-scoped rate-limit and disable streaming for northstar to avoid chunking stalls. 2) fallback: route to quantized low-latency model variant (lower token quality) 3) longer: increase KV cache size on affected pool + evict policy tweak.

alice_oncall: do 1) now. miguel, can you flip streaming off for their customer_id? also set a 5rps soft limit per session. I'll coordinate with CS.

miguel_runtime: executing tenant controls. running command: `rdwctl tenant update northstar --streaming=false --session-rps=5`

k8s-deploy-bot: Deploy started: tenant-config-updater v1.9 -> 3 pods. rollout id=deploy-20260314-456.

miguel_runtime: rollout applied. patch shows streaming disabled for northstar routes on the ingress.

davinder_sre: metrics after action (T+2m): p99 dropped to 3.1s, p95 820ms, errors down to 0.3%. still above SLO but much improved.

lia_prodeng: note: disabling streaming reduces perceived latency for tail cases but increases token-cost sometimes. we flagged for billing team.

tom_cs: northstar confirms degraded but usable experience; their test harness paused the canary and will revert debug blob. they asked for a short postmortem and action items.

miguel_runtime: while streaming was off we also observed model-serving pods with high RSS and repeated GC stalls on a few nodes. suspects are long-lived per-request allocations from JSON serialization. I've collected heap profiles: s3://redwood-logs/profiles/northstar/2101234567.heap.gz

alice_oncall: next steps: 1) keep streaming off for 30m, 2) ask northstar to revert prompt change, 3) run canary against quantized model in a sandbox, 4) schedule follow-up postmortem and add a playbook entry for "tenant large-system-prompt".

davinder_sre: creating incident doc now: https://docs.redwood/incidents/2101234567-northstar-streaming-surge. tagging eng-runtime, eng-sre, product.

lia_prodeng: for longer term: add tenant-level prompt-length enforcement in the gateway, telemetry for system prompt size, and automatic fallback to non-streaming when prefix > 3k tokens. filing a JIRA: INF-8942.

miguel_runtime: I'll also add an instrumentation point: per-request KV write ops + size histogram so we can catch heavy KV churn early.

alice_oncall: handing off to davinder for follow-up and postmortem. I'll remain available for escalations. 

davinder_sre: ack. summary for handoff: mitigation applied (streaming off, rate-limit 5rps), immediate customer impact reduced to acceptable degraded mode, root cause likely: canary adding large debug blob causing KV cache thrash + GC pressure -> streaming chunk timeouts. next: postmortem + playbook + telemetry. 

tom_cs: i'll coordinate customer comms and include rollback guidance. northstar asks for ETA on restoring streaming once they revert; recommend re-enable after canary with smaller prompts or after route to quantized model test.

k8s-deploy-bot: Deploy completed: tenant-config-updater v1.9 -> 3 pods. status=success.

davinder_sre: last checks: p99 = 980ms, p95 = 450ms, errors 0.11% at T+12m. closing active incident phase. will keep this thread open for postmortem notes.

alice_oncall: thanks all. leaving a short oncall note: "2101234567 northstar: streaming disabled + rate-limited; revert heavy system prompts; follow-up INF-8942; assigned davinder + miguel + lia." :white_check_mark:
note: Created during an on-call incident involving tenant-specific streaming stalls and tail latency; includes bot pages, mitigation commands, logs, metrics links, and handoff summary.
